description: This file provides a React hook 'useSearchFilter' that generates search filter conditions based on input value, list metadata, and search fields, primarily used in filtering relationship fields within Keystone CMS.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the given string represents an integer.

methods.name: isBigInt
methods.description: Checks if the given string can be converted to a BigInt.

methods.name: isUuid
methods.description: Checks if the given string matches the UUID format.

methods.name: useSearchFilter
methods.description: Main hook that returns a memoized array of filter conditions based on the input value, list metadata, and search fields.
